The four dark, beady eyes, the fuzziness, the “moustache” looking chelicerae or palps, and the friendly attitude just won me over.
After jumping_arachnid’s Putnam’s Jumping Spider ID, I see that this one is a female, with the four spike “hairdo” and brown/beige coloring.
She was seen on the bench outside the kitchen door.
